record.field: Functional: Inventory, traceability, pricelists, Point of Sale
No code: put the donated objects for sale, open the till with a social pricelist… and find a chest of drawers that vanished.

field.name: description
field.p: La Ressourcerie collects donated objects, repairs them and sells them at solidarity prices in its shop. Help the volunteers manage their stock and their till with Odoo.
No code in this challenge: everything is done in the interface of Odoo, on your Odoo.sh database.

ol.li: The articles (Inventory): 8 products whose inventory is tracked, in 3 product categories Vêtements, Meubles and Électro, each with a sales price.

The social pricelist (settings of the Point of Sale, Flexible Pricelists; these settings need a shop: create it first with the tile Retail, see task 4): activate the pricelists, create a pricelist Tarif social giving 50 % off, and make it available in the shop.
A donation (Inventory): receive and validate the donation of a few objects from the contact Donateur anonyme.
The till (Point of Sale): create the shop of the Ressourcerie (the tile Retail is enough), open a session and make 3 sales, one of them at the Tarif social.
The end of the day: close the session of the till.

The lost chest of drawers (Inventory): Josiane Feller brought back the Art Deco chest of drawers she had bought, because a drawer was broken… and nobody has seen it since. Find it, create an internal location Atelier réparation, and move this very chest of drawers there.

field.p: ⭐ Bonus: an appealing sales description on the 8 articles; the Tarif social limited to one product category; a customer on a ticket; the analysis of the sales by product category (Point of Sale › Reporting › Orders) saved in your favorites.
